title: 第16章 太轻了第17章 正牌铁匠
content_zh:
第十六章 太轻了
如果是以前，乾劲调头就走了，大不了再去找一份工作就是了。可今天连番的寻找工作碰壁，好容易逮着这么个机会，哪里肯立刻放弃。
“我跟他们不同，能让我试试吗？”
乾劲话语刚刚出口，弗兰林铁匠铺前堂的几名伙计，还有面前那名大汉一同高声笑了其中。
一名正在摆放刀剑的伙计笑呵呵的说道：“小战士，你这话我们不是第一次听了。几乎每个奥克兰的学员来时，都这么说的。结果，他们无一例外的证明，他们都是一样的。”
乾劲心中暗骂，靠！这也太巧了吧？以前那些人搞什么啊搞？
“弗兰西，你小子又在前堂偷懒！”
带着几分怒意的声音，后堂走出一名身材不高，全身肌肉显得格外结实，好似矮人的人类，他手里提着一个足有百斤重的打铁锤，两条粗粗的金黄色眉毛高高挑起。
“哥哥，我可没有偷懒。”大汉弗兰西向后小跳了一步，好像很惧怕来人的样子连连摇头，大铁锤子一指乾劲赶忙说道：“是这小子，他说想要来这里应聘，我劝他离开……”
“你？”来人提着百斤打铁锤，眼睛划过跟弗兰西一样不信任的眼光，空着的左手连连摆动：“小子，你是奥克兰战士与魔法学院的吧？好好学你的战士吧，别来我们这里捣乱，打铁也不是随便就能做的。”
同样的话语，同样的态度，乾劲心中将以前来参加应聘的所有前辈狠狠的骂了一番，奥克兰战士与魔法学院在四海英雄会上每次预选赛都淘汰，怎么现在混得在个铁匠铺的名声都这么臭了？这事情要是传出去，也足够奥克兰战士与魔法学院丢次人的了。
低头看看自己身上这套奥克兰战士与魔法学院的衣服，乾劲多少有些后悔穿校服出门，就因为这身在很多人眼中都会高看一眼的衣服，今天在这铁匠铺竟然被人连番鄙视。
乾劲又瞟了一眼男人手中，那从外形看就知道，足有百斤的重锤，心中多少有些没底。
虽然在那个叫做‘无尽世界’的什么虚拟游戏中，打了十六个小时的铁，莫名其妙的力量增长不少，但不代表铁真的就那样打。
“不如，让我试试？”乾劲耸耸肩膀：“你们不是招人吗？让我试一下，你们又不会损失什么。”
“老板，让他试试呗。”
“就是啊，让他试试吧。”
几名门前台负责贩卖货物的年轻人，纷纷对着那好似矮人的人类起哄，乾劲才知道这人就是这家店铺的老板，弗兰林。
费兰林无力的看了眼几名起哄的年轻人，这些人就是喜欢看热闹，特别是喜欢看奥克兰魔法与战士学院的学员出丑的样子。
弗兰林又看了一眼乾劲，算不上粗壮但依然能够算上健壮的身材，至少在这个年纪如此身材算是健壮，肌肉凸起充满弹性却不会僵硬，从外在的素质上来说，倒是有着打铁的基本素质，只是打铁这东西也还是要学的，铁匠铺可不想请一个什么都不会的人来做事。

“好吧。”弗兰林提着那百来斤的大铁锤走向后院，口气中充满了不抱希望的味道：“你试试看吧。”
弗兰西提着自己的打铁锤，满脸带着期待看笑话的表情，紧紧跟在乾劲的身后走进了后院。
后院跟前台完全不同，乾劲的腿脚刚刚迈入后院的地界，顿时感觉到一股股灼热的气浪扑面而来，那无序的铁锤敲击声更是此起彼伏，刺目的火星飞溅不止，一个个壮汉脱光了上衣，汗水在他们赤裸的上身不是流淌，将下身的衣裤都浸湿。
不时有打铁的铁匠停下手中的工作，好奇的看着身边走过的乾劲，随后粗着嗓子对走在前面的弗兰林吼道：“老板，你怎么弄了个奥克兰魔法与战士学院的学生来啊？今天的娱乐节目吗？”
粗犷的吼声，顿时引来不少人的笑声，弗兰林无奈的摇晃着大脑袋，虽然早知道这奥克兰魔法与战士学院的学生抗击魔族还行，打铁根本就没什么可能，但谁叫现在铁匠铺确实缺人手？也只能抱着赌运气想法，来看看是否能捡到一个勉强稍微会点打铁的工人也好。
乾劲跟着弗兰林来到一个小火炉旁边停住了脚步，弗兰林仰头担忧的看着乾劲，随手抓了一块生铁丢入火炉不抱希望的说道：“试试吧，小心铁烧红了会很烫，就算你有斗劲护体，也还是会被烫伤。”
乾劲听到这话，心头涌上一阵无力的挫败感，难道我的长相会给人一种很愚蠢的味道？铁烧红了会烫，这是基本常识啊！不会是哪位前辈学长，曾经想在这里表演一下自己那强大的斗劲，结果被烫伤了手吧？这也太给学院抹黑了吧？
升腾的火焰将生铁一点点烧的变成了红色，弗兰林看了看生铁的颜色，对着墙角处摆放的几把铁锤努了努嘴：“随便去挑一把，开始吧。”
乾劲看了看摆放在墙角的打铁锤，最重的也不过三十几斤的样子，虽然只在那个【无尽的世界】中用了一次打铁锤，但还是觉得比较习惯那种重锤，而且看起来也相对威风一些。
乾劲站在原地没有动，附近几名铁匠笑声中带着三分的调侃：“小战士，你是不是拿不动这些重锤？没关系，你向右边看，那里还有三斤的小锤。”
调侃的话语，顿时再次引来相对远处一些铁匠的笑声，几乎所有人这时都停住了手中的工作，想要看看这位奥克兰学院的战士，接下来的‘精彩表现’，这样的事情众人以前看过不少，却没有看厌烦的感觉。
“这个……”乾劲抬手挠着后脑勺的头发，口中啧啧道：“这些都太轻了……”
后院的笑声，停止了。
十几名铁匠，表情古怪的如同嘴里被塞了十几个鸡蛋，脸颊跟眼角肌肉从僵硬变得快速抽搐，紧接着哄堂的大笑声回荡在铁匠铺的上空，有人甚至笑的捂住肚子弯下了腰。

content_en:
Chapter 16 Too light
If it were before, the energy would turn around and leave, and the worst possible thing would be to find another job. But today, I encountered many obstacles in my job search. I finally caught such an opportunity, but I was not willing to give up immediately.
"I'm different from them, can you let me try?"
As soon as the energetic words came out, several of the clerks in the front hall of Franlin's Blacksmith Shop and the big man in front of him laughed loudly.
A clerk who was placing the swords said with a smile: "Little warrior, this is not the first time we have heard what you said. Almost every student from Auckland said this when they came. As a result, they proved without exception that they are all the same."
Gan Jin cursed secretly in his heart, Damn! What a coincidence, right? What were those people doing in the past?
"Francie, you kid is slacking off in the front hall again!"
With a somewhat angry voice, a short human came out of the back hall, his muscles all over were extremely strong, like a dwarf. He was holding a hammer weighing a hundred kilograms in his hand, and his two thick golden eyebrows were raised high.
"Brother, I'm not lazy." The big man France took a small step back and shook his head repeatedly as if he was afraid of the coming people. He pointed his big iron hammer and said quickly: "It's this kid. He said he wanted to apply here. I advised him to leave..."
"You?" The person who came here was carrying a hundred-pound hammer, his eyes flashed with the same distrust as France's, and his free left hand waved repeatedly: "Boy, are you from the Oakland Warrior and Magic Academy? Learn from your warriors and don't come to make trouble here. Blacksmithing is not something you can do casually."
With the same words, the same attitude, he vigorously scolded all the seniors who had applied for the job in the past. The Oakland Warriors and the Magic Academy were eliminated in every qualifying match in the Heroes of the World Conference. How come the reputation of being in a blacksmith shop is so bad now? If this matter spreads, it will be enough to embarrass the Oakland Warriors and the Magic Academy.
Looking down at the clothes he wore from the Oakland Warrior and Magic Academy, he felt somewhat regretful about wearing the school uniform and going out. Just because he was wearing clothes that many people would look down upon, he was despised by many people in this blacksmith shop today.
Ganjin glanced at the man's hand again. Judging from its appearance, it was a heavy hammer weighing a hundred kilograms, and he felt a little unsure.
Although in some virtual game called "Endless World", after playing iron for sixteen hours, my strength inexplicably increased a lot, it does not mean that iron is really played like that.
"Why don't you let me try?" Ganjin shrugged: "Aren't you recruiting people? Let me try. You won't lose anything."
"Boss, let him try it."
"That's right, let him try it."
Several young people who were responsible for selling goods at the front desk started hesitating at the dwarf-like human being. Only then did he realize that this person was the owner of the store, Franlin.
Fei Lanlin looked helplessly at the few young people who were making noises. These people just liked to watch the fun, especially the students from the Oakland Academy of Magic and Warriors making fools of themselves.
Flanlin took another look at the energy. He couldn't be considered stout but could still be considered a strong figure. At least at this age, the figure was considered strong. The muscles were bulging and full of elasticity but not stiff. In terms of external qualities, he had the basic qualities of blacksmithing, but blacksmithing still had to be learned. The blacksmith shop did not want to hire someone who knew nothing to work.
"Okay." Flanlin walked to the backyard carrying the sledgehammer that weighed a hundred pounds, and his tone was full of hopelessness: "You give it a try."
Francie held her hammer in hand and followed Gan Jin closely behind him into the backyard with an expression on her face that looked forward to seeing a joke.
The backyard is completely different from the front desk. As soon as my energetic legs stepped into the backyard, I suddenly felt waves of hot air hitting my face., the disorderly hammering sounds came one after another, and dazzling sparks kept flying. One by one, the strong men took off their shirts, and sweat was flowing on their naked upper bodies, soaking their lower clothes.
From time to time, a blacksmith stops his work and looks curiously at the people walking by him. Then he shouts in a rough voice to Flanlin who is walking in front: "Boss, why did you get a student from the Oakland Academy of Magic and Warriors to come? Is it today's entertainment program?"
The rough roar immediately attracted laughter from many people. Franlin shook his big head helplessly. Although he had known that this student from the Oakland Academy of Magic and Warriors could fight against the demons, there was no possibility of blacksmithing, but who said that the blacksmith shop is really short of manpower now? I can only gamble my luck and see if I can pick up a worker who is barely good at blacksmithing.
Ganjin followed Flanlin to a small stove and stopped. Flanlin raised his head and looked at Ganjin worriedly. He grabbed a piece of pig iron and threw it into the stove and said without hope: "Try it, be careful. The iron will be very hot when it burns red. Even if you have Doujin body protection, you will still get burned."
Hearing this, Gan Jin felt a sense of helpless frustration. Could it be that my appearance gave people a sense of stupidity? When iron is red, it will get hot. This is basic common sense! Could it be that some senior student once wanted to show off his powerful fighting skills here, but ended up getting his hands burned? Doesn't this discredit the academy too much?
The rising flames turned the pig iron into red bit by bit. Franlin looked at the color of the pig iron and pouted at the hammers placed in the corner: "Just pick one and let's get started."
Ganjin looked at the hammers placed in the corner. The heaviest one only weighed more than thirty kilograms. Although he only used the hammer once in the [Endless World], he still felt more accustomed to that kind of heavy hammer, and it looked relatively majestic.
Ganjin stood still and did not move. Several blacksmiths nearby laughed with a hint of ridicule: "Little soldier, can't you lift these heavy hammers? It doesn't matter. Look to the right, there are three-pound hammers there."
The joking words immediately aroused the laughter of some blacksmiths relatively far away again. Almost everyone stopped what they were doing at this time, wanting to see the "wonderful performance" of this warrior from Oakland Academy. Everyone had seen a lot of such things before, but they didn't feel bored watching it.
"This..." Ganjin raised his hand and scratched the hair on the back of his head and said, "These are too light..."
The laughter in the backyard stopped.
More than a dozen blacksmiths had strange expressions, as if they had more than a dozen eggs stuffed into their mouths. The muscles in their cheeks and eye corners changed from stiffness to rapid twitching. Then roars of laughter echoed over the blacksmith shop. Some people even covered their stomachs and bent down while laughing.
